stock.description: Lai Fung Holdings Limited, an investment holding company established in 1997 and based in Central, Hong Kong, primarily focuses on the real estate sector. Its activities involve both the development and acquisition of properties across Mainland China, Hong Kong, and various international locations. The company's operations are divided into four principal divisions: property development, property investment, the management of hotels and serviced apartments, and the operation of theme parks. Lai Fung's portfolio includes the creation of residential, office, and commercial buildings, as well as investing in and developing hospitality properties like hotels and serviced apartments. Furthermore, it engages in the establishment and management of cultural, leisure, and entertainment facilities. Beyond these core areas, the company also provides property and building management services and directly oversees the functioning of theme parks. Lai Fung Holdings Limited operates as a subsidiary of Lai Sun Development Company Limited.
